name: ecoctx
description: An audit of what your coding agent reads before it does anything, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: ecoctx
plugins.description: ecoctx audits the context your coding agent loads on every turn - CLAUDE.md, indexes, every installed skill's description - and measures what each costs in tokens. It ranks what can really be changed, then grades each prediction against what the fix actually bought. Sixteen steps, two phases, and a record another person can check.
